name: AutoCert
overview: Automatic HTTPS certificates with GoDaddy, Cloudflare, or DigitalOcean DNS verification.
description: Obtain and renew Let's Encrypt certificates, generate password-protected PFX files, and update Jellyfin HTTPS settings. Supports GoDaddy API key/secret or PAT. Initial test release: begin with staging.

versions.changelog: Adds GoDaddy classic API key and secret authentication. Includes automatic renewal, PFX password rotation, optional restart, and rollback.
